mapper.sql: SELECT CAST(r.id AS CHAR) AS id,GREATEST(r.recorded_at,a.occurred_at) AS recorded_at, JSON_OBJECT('attemptId',CAST(a.id AS CHAR),'requestId',a.request_id,'traceId',a.trace_id, 'actorId',a.actor_id,'occurredAt',DATE_FORMAT(a.occurred_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'), 'policyVersion',a.policy_version,'action',r.action_code,'result',r.result_code,'errorCode',r.error_code, 'applicationId',r.application_id,'applicationNo',r.application_no,'orderId',r.order_id,'orderNo',r.order_no, 'tradeTenant',p.checkout_trade_tenant,'checkoutReference',p.checkout_ref,'campaignId',r.campaign_id, 'originalEffectId',CAST(r.original_effect_id AS CHAR),'commandHash',r.command_hash,'beforeState',r.before_state,'afterState',r.after_state, 'amountMinor',CAST(r.amount_minor AS CHAR),'currency',r.currency) AS fact FROM mk_funding_audit_result r JOIN mk_funding_audit_attempt a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.id=r.attempt_id JOIN mk_promotion_application p ON p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND p.application_id=r.application_id AND p.order_id=r.order_id
mapper.select: SELECT state FROM mk_operation_audit_archive_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{batchId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT approval_reference AS approvalReference,reviewed_through AS reviewedThrough FROM mk_funding_archive_cutover_grant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{batchId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND effective_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FOR UPDATE

SELECT case_reference FROM mk_funding_archive_hold FORCE INDEX(ix_funding_archive_hold) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND released_at IS NULL AND (application_id IS NULL OR application_id=#{applicationId}) FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mk_funding_audit_result WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND id IN #{id}
DELETE FROM mk_funding_audit_attempt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_operation_audit_archive_batch SET state='ONLINE_PURGED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{batchId} AND object_version=#{version} AND state='VERIFIED'
mapper.select: SELECT batch_id FROM mk_funding_archive_cutover_receipt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND recovery_version IS NULL ORDER BY batch_id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_operation_audit_archive_batch SET state='ONLINE_PURGED',object_version=#{batch.objectVersion},payload=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{batch.batchId} AND sha256=#{batch.sha256} AND (object_version IS NULL OR object_version=#{batch.objectVersion}) AND state<>'ONLINE_PURGED'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO mk_funding_archive_effect_locator(tenant_id,effect_id,application_id,action_code,command_hash,batch_id) VALUES (#{tenant},#{effect.effectId},#{effect.applicationId},#{effect.actionCode},#{effect.commandHash},#{effect.batchId})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE effect_id=mk_funding_archive_effect_locator.effect_id
mapper.select: SELECT effect_id AS effectId,application_id AS applicationId,action_code AS actionCode,command_hash AS commandHash, batch_id AS batchId FROM mk_funding_archive_effect_locator WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND effect_id IN #{id} ORDER BY effect_id FOR UPDATE
